n: 30 Inch S Series Professional Freestanding Electric Range Stainless Steel
desc: THOR Kitchen 30-inch Professional Freestanding Electric Range delivers modern design and powerful performance in one seamless package. Featuring a frameless smooth glass cooktop that sits flush within a 30-inch space, it offers a sleek, contemporary look with effortless cleaning.
hl: Designed to fit seamlessly into a 30-inch space, this freestanding electric range features a sleek, frameless glass top that sits flush with the countertop for a modern look and effortless cleaning.
Versatile four-element cooktop delivers flexible cooking power, ranging from a 1,200W element for gentle heating to a powerful 3,000W element for rapid boiling and high-heat searing.
Built-in convection fan circulates hot air evenly throughout the oven for faster, more consistent cooking results.
spec: Canada only. Not included in USA / Mexico.
